items.title: Fal raises $1.3bn at a $16bn valuation, led by Bessemer
items.summary: Fal, which hosts generative media models, announced a $1.3bn Series F led by Bessemer; Nvidia, Sound Ventures and T. Rowe Price took part; valuation doubled from $8bn in April to $16bn.
items.why_it_matters: Investors still pay large premiums for AI inference infrastructure.
